question: Can new federated Panoramax coverage plus the official viewer-equivalent effective-zero pose contract supply at least three close, globally DIRECT, cross-collection exact entrance pairs?
information_change: Change the observation source twice but keep portal truth fixed: add five high-coverage French cities from the live federated catalog, and replace explicit pose-field presence with Panoramax web-viewer 5.2.0's exact effective-zero resolution. Do not change the matcher, threshold, crop, backbone, tracker or portal definition.

projection.comparison: Run every returned item through both gates; select only with the successor and retain the strict counts as the unchanged counterfactual.

targets.city_rule: For each bbox query named building ways with entrance=main, choose the lowest-ID main entrance per way, prioritize amenity/tourism/shop/office/leisure/healthcare/historic-tagged ways, then way ID and entrance ID. Freeze the first 80 before any Panoramax search.

selection.pair_rule: After global geometry, keep DIRECT items only. For each entrance choose a pair from distinct collection UUIDs by minimum maximum distance, then camera-bearing delta, distance delta, collection IDs and item IDs. Select five distinct ways in the same order.
selection.role_order: Lexicographic collection ID then item ID; first is REFERENCE and second is QUERY.

geometry.rule: Camera must be outside the target. The target way must be the unique first global building-boundary owner and its first intersection must be within 0.75 m of the exact entrance node. Owner ties within 0.25 m are excluded.

source_admission.viewport: Reuse the frozen 1024x768, 90-degree horizontal FOV, -10-degree pitch and x=512 portal ray from l10_panolab_close_portal_source_protocol_v1.json.
source_admission.reference_role: Reference-only reviewer sees only the five frozen reference viewports and x=512.
source_admission.query_role: Disjoint query-only reviewer sees only the five frozen query viewports and x=512.
source_admission.formal_rule: Retain the first three episodes independently ADMITTED in both roles. If fewer than three are joint, close without a matcher call.

stop_condition: After this one metadata discovery, either materialize its frozen cohort or replace the observation source. After one role-separated pixel audit, either run the unchanged exact-portal patch transfer or close without matcher tuning.
claim_boundary: This is Development source acquisition. Metadata admission is not portal visibility or transfer, active-view causality, public/legal access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, user benefit or mobility-safety evidence.
